caption: A bearded man in a tall green feathered top hat and an ornate purple-and-gold jacket stands against a pure black background. He holds a connected cluster of large iridescent soap bubbles between two open palms, his gaze tracking the shimmering forms. The cluster is already stretched between his raised right hand and his left hand near his chest. His right hand lifts further, drawing the chain of bubbles upward and tilting it, while his left hand rises toward his face. Both hands then converge in front of his face, compressing and reshaping the cluster as his mouth purses. Afterward the cupped hands and the sagging, deforming bubbles descend together toward his lower chest. The cluster keeps shifting as the clip ends.
